financials.source: Form 990 for EIN 91-0565816 not verified via ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer due to search limitations. VMFH is a subsidiary of CommonSpirit Health (EIN 86-1223604), which reports consolidated financials. VMFH operates 10 hospitals and 300+ sites of care in the Puget Sound region. Parent CommonSpirit reported consolidated net assets of $14.4B as of June 2024. Web searches required to pull entity-level 990 data.

VMFH operates 10 hospitals in Washington state: Virginia Mason Medical Center (Seattle), St. Joseph Medical Center (Tacoma), St. Francis Hospital (Federal Way), St. Anthony Hospital (Gig Harbor), St. Clare Hospital (Lakewood), St. Elizabeth Hospital (Enumclaw), St. Michael Medical Center (Silverdale), Highline Medical Center (Burien), St. Anne Hospital (Burien), and Rehabilitation Hospital (Tacoma).
balanceSheetWealth.notes: VMFH's balance sheet is consolidated into CommonSpirit Health, which held $14.4B in net assets as of June 2024. Entity-level assets for EIN 91-0565816 not verified. Virginia Mason Foundation exists as a separate fundraising entity.

bondDebt.source: VMFH debt is incorporated into CommonSpirit Health's master trust indenture (MTI). CommonSpirit issued $504.1M in Washington state tax-exempt bonds (Series 2025A) through the Washington Health Care Facilities Authority per S&P September 2025 report. Legacy CHI Franciscan and Virginia Mason debt was folded into the CommonSpirit MTI. Total CommonSpirit system debt was approximately $13.7B pre-merger ($8.5B CHI + $5.2B Dignity Health). Entity-level VMFH bond debt not separately verified via EMMA.

relatedOrganizations.source: Schedule R not verified due to search limitations. VMFH formed in January 2021 from the combination of Virginia Mason Medical Center and CHI Franciscan Health, both under CommonSpirit Health. CHI Franciscan was part of Catholic Health Initiatives, which merged with Dignity Health to form CommonSpirit in 2019. Virginia Mason affiliated with CommonSpirit in 2021.

executiveComp.source: Executive compensation from Form 990 Schedule J for EIN 91-0565816 not verified due to search limitations. Ketul Patel served as CEO of VMFH; leadership transitions have occurred. Parent CommonSpirit Health CEO is Wright Lassiter III. Compensation data requires 990 verification.

communityBenefit.source: Community benefit from Form 990 Schedule H for EIN 91-0565816 not verified due to search limitations. Washington state requires nonprofit hospitals to develop community health needs assessments and implementation strategies. Washington Attorney General has oversight of nonprofit hospital conversions and charity care compliance under RCW 70.170.

taxAdvantage.notes: VMFH operates 10 hospitals and 300+ care sites across Washington state, all property-tax-exempt. Washington state has no personal income tax but does have a business & occupation (B&O) tax from which nonprofits receive exemptions. Tax-exempt bond interest subsidy applies through CommonSpirit's master trust indenture. Total tax advantage not quantified.
